rationale: The artifact_interaction payload contract is documented (EVENT-SCHEMA.md, ARTIFACT_CONTROL_LEVELS.md) and schema-registered (ArtifactInteractionVariant) as top-level artifact_id/level/action fields composing with the envelope, and the built-in --serve dashboard's Send control already POSTs exactly that shape; nesting under payload would break both the documented contract and the dashboard's own emitter.
rule: Strip/rename the four envelope keys (event, ts, run_id, loop) from the inbound artifact_interaction body before spreading it, rather than nesting the whole body under a new payload key
alternatives_rejected: Nest the raw inbound body under a new payload key (Option A) — rejected because it moves artifact_id/level/action under event.payload.*, breaking the documented/schema-registered contract and the dashboard's own emitter
